//: The one place the mobile app is configured. Packaged as a MauiAsset and read at startup by MobileSettings.Load(). Mirrors App.Web/wwwroot/appsettings.json.
//ApiBaseUrl: Release builds: the production API behind https://enityasannidhi.com (Caddy on the VPS proxies /api to the API container). Keep in sync with deploy/vps/Caddyfile.
//ApiBaseUrlDebug: Debug builds on iOS simulator, Windows and Mac Catalyst, which share the host's loopback.
//ApiBaseUrlDebugAndroid: Debug builds on the Android emulator, which reaches the host through 10.0.2.2 rather than 127.0.0.1.
//HttpTimeoutSeconds: Generous because the API's host cold-starts and a phone on a weak signal is the case that needs the headroom.
//GoogleServerClientId: Sign in with Google on Android. The Google OAuth 'Web application' client id (the same value the API holds in Google__ClientIds__0), NOT the Android client id: Credential Manager asks Google for a token addressed to this id. The Android OAuth client must still exist for the app's package name and signing SHA-1, or Google refuses. Empty hides the button. iOS shows no Google button until Sign in with Apple is added.
